_meta.name: English
_meta.note: User-facing strings only. Arrays are joined with newlines. {name} is a format argument.

tools.search_records: Search published records. query is an Invenio search expression (empty matches everything). Returns summary fields only.
tools.get_record: Fetch one record. draft=True fetches the draft.
create_record: Create a new record. metadata is an Invenio metadata object
files_enabled=False makes it metadata-only. publish=True publishes it right away.
update_record: Update an existing record's metadata. For a published record this does
metadata is the complete metadata object (a replacement, not a patch).
publish=False leaves it as a draft.
tools.new_version: Create a draft of a new version. Passing metadata replaces it; publish=True publishes right away.
tools.delete_draft: Discard a draft (unpublished, or the draft of an edit in progress).
delete_record: Soft-delete a published record, leaving a tombstone that returns HTTP 410.
Requires an admin token. Does nothing without confirm=True.
reason_id comes from the removalreasons vocabulary
(out-of-scope / duplicate / spam / retracted and so on).
tools.restore_record: Restore a soft-deleted published record. Requires an admin token.
add_file: Add a file to a draft (init -> content -> commit). The record must have
Give the content as one of text (UTF-8), content_base64, or source_path
tools.list_files: List the files of a record or draft.
tools.delete_file: Delete a file from a draft.

errors.token_missing: INVENIO_TOKEN is unset and there is no .token file
errors.content_required: one of text / content_base64 / source_path is required
errors.destructive_needs_confirm: This is a destructive operation. Pass confirm=True.
